services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Tripped circuits, blown fuses, or dead sockets? We diagnose and fix faults on the same day, often within hours of your call.

services.title: Full House Rewiring
services.desc: Upgrading an older property or extending? We design and install new circuits to modern standards, with all work certified for insurance.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Strange burning smells or flickering lights? We locate the root cause with professional testing equipment and put it right.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Modern consumer units protect your home better and allow for EV charging or heat pump installation. We handle the lot.

services.title: Lighting & Power Installation
services.desc: New pendant lights, outdoor sockets, or a full kitchen rewire — we install cleanly and ensure everything meets building regs.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: Your EICR (electrical condition report) keeps your tenancy compliant and your insurance valid. We complete it within 24 hours.

about_pullquote: Started this to do honest work at fair prices, not to rip people off.
about_para_1: Reeson Electrical has been serving Newcastle homeowners and landlords for 18 years. We built the business on straightforward diagnosis, no nonsense, and genuinely helpful advice — you only pay for what you actually need. From small repairs to complete rewires, every job is done to Part P standards and fully certified.
about_para_2: We're based in Wellburn and cover Newcastle and the surrounding areas. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals — a sign that people trust us to show up on time, do the job right, and charge fairly. If a fault can be fixed quickly, we'll say so; if it needs a bigger job, we explain the options and let you decide.

reviews.text: Called Reeson on a Friday evening with a tripped circuit board — thought I'd have to wait till Monday. Dave came out within an hour, found a faulty socket, replaced it, and had everything working again. Very professional, no faffing about. Will use again without question.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had them in for a full rewire on a 1960s semi. Explained everything clearly, worked methodically, made good on their quotes. Tidy workers too — didn't leave a mess. Got my EICR done the same day, so insurance is happy. Top job.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Honest bunch. My electrician mate reckoned I needed a new consumer unit, but Reeson's bloke said a couple of new breakers would do. Saved me a fortune. That's the kind of integrity you want on your side.
reviews.author: James B.
